LESSON: STANDING FIRM IN FAITH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.3: Standing Firm in Faith

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Standing Firm in Faith. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you stand firm in your Christian faith? 2. Why should you not join ungodly groups?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the city where believers were first called Christians,
2. retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith,
3. list three lessons learnt from the stoning of Stephen,
4. explain why they should not join ungodly groups, e) utilise the virtue of assertiveness and stand firm in faith. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Standing Firm in Faith.
2. Explain Standing Firm in Faith to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing a song related to standing firm in the Christian faith,
